<!-- before body ends-->
```{=HTML} 


<script>
$(document).ready(function() {
  $('#dude-img').tooltip({
    html: true,
    placement: 'top',
    trigger: 'hover focus',
    container: 'body',
    template: `
      <div class="tooltip dude-tooltip" role="tooltip">
        <div class="arrow"></div>
        <div class="tooltip-inner"></div>
      </div>
    `
  });
});
</script>

<script>

$.get('/CONTENT/main/intro_start.md', function(txt) {
    const htmlContent = marked.parse(txt);
    $('#intro_start').html(htmlContent);
    
});

</script>


<!-- intro text as modal -->
 
<script>

$.get('./CONTENT/main/intro_start.md', function(txt) {
  const readMore = `
    <button type="button" class="show-read-more read-more-inline" aria-label="Read more">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-ellipsis" aria-hidden="true"></i>
    </button>
  `;

  const htmlContent = marked.parse(txt).replace('{{read-more}}', readMore);
  $('#intro_start').html(htmlContent);
});


$(document).on('click', '#intro_start .show-read-more', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopPropagation();

  $.get('./CONTENT/main/intro.md', function(introText) {
    bootbox.alert({
      animate: false,
      scrollable: true,
      size: 'xl',
      centerVertical: true,
      message: marked.parse(introText),
      backdrop: true,
      closeButton: true,
      onShow: function() {
        $(this).find('.modal-footer').remove();
      }
    });
  });
});


</script>





```
